classes.name: Task Attempt claim must activate exactly one matching coordination dispatch
classes.trigger: A Task Attempt claim is processed while the coordination-dispatch projection does not contain exactly one matching active dispatch.
classes.observed_symptom: Auto-mode records iteration-error/unit-abandon and may hit the liveness backstop; repeated unchanged inputs produce a blocked auto-exit wedge.
classes.product_impact: none observed in the law-nexus product runtime; failure is in GSD lifecycle coordination.

sanctioned_lifecycle_recovery.method: Use the sanctioned diagnostic/repair path to reconcile the matching dispatch and resume the affected unit; do not mutate gsd.db directly.
sanctioned_lifecycle_recovery.limits: The evidence identifies the defect but does not establish an in-project permanent engine fix.

evidence_refs.detail: Task Attempt claim must activate exactly one matching coordination dispatch
Inventory records 190 occurrences and preserves the no-external-paths-read boundary.

classes.name: gate-evaluate completed-no-advance wedge
classes.trigger: A gate-evaluate unit reports completion without changing any of its target rows.
classes.observed_symptom: The liveness backstop repeats completed-no-advance and stops auto-mode with a wedge; examples include M203/S02 and M203/S03 gate evaluations.
classes.product_impact: none observed in the law-nexus product runtime; gate persistence/advance is the affected lifecycle surface.

sanctioned_lifecycle_recovery.method: Inspect the unit summary and reconcile state through sanctioned GSD status/doctor/repair or resume paths, then rerun the gate unit.
sanctioned_lifecycle_recovery.limits: Recovery can unblock a unit but does not prove the external advance guard is fixed.

classes.name: plan-slice artifact-verification failure caused by research citing paths outside the project root
classes.trigger: Research evidence supplied to plan-slice contains a path outside the active project root, so artifact verification cannot establish project-local provenance.
classes.observed_symptom: plan-slice artifact verification rejects the research-backed plan rather than accepting an out-of-project reference; the unit cannot advance until evidence is rewritten with project-local refs.
classes.product_impact: none observed in the law-nexus product runtime; this is a planning/evidence-boundary failure.

sanctioned_lifecycle_recovery.method: Replace the research citation with a project-local evidence ref, rerun sanctioned research/plan-slice verification, and resume the unit.
sanctioned_lifecycle_recovery.limits: No external checkout or engine source may be read or edited from this project.

evidence_refs.detail: The local research result is the source-bound record used to diagnose the plan-slice artifact-verification/path-boundary failure; no external path was read.

classes.name: execute-task completion abort caused by passing the escalation field to gsd_task_complete
classes.trigger: An execute-task closeout passes the escalation field to gsd_task_complete, although this build's durable adapter does not support that field.
classes.observed_symptom: The completion call aborts with `Canonical Task completion escalation is not yet supported by the durable completion adapter`; task closeout is not persisted by that invocation.
classes.product_impact: none observed in the law-nexus product runtime; the failure is in the durable GSD completion adapter contract.

sanctioned_lifecycle_recovery.method: Retry the same task closeout without the unsupported escalation field, preserving honest knownIssues/blocked information in supported fields.
sanctioned_lifecycle_recovery.limits: This is a compatibility workaround, not an engine repair; do not claim the adapter defect is fixed.

evidence_refs.detail: Canonical Task completion escalation is not yet supported by the durable completion adapter
Repeated historical occurrence of the same durable-adapter rejection.

negative_boundary: This artifact uses only project-local inventory, journal, activity, and runtime surfaces. It does not read or modify an external GSD checkout, upstream source, or database file.
